settings.title: Settings — Bring Your Own Key
settings.subtitle: Plug in your own paid API key per capability to get paid-tier quality without a subscription. Keys are encrypted server-side; only the last 4 characters are ever shown here.
settings.templatesSubtitle: If set, a campaign can choose to build on top of your own ad image or email layout instead of a fully generated one. The full pipeline (feasibility, personas, creative) still runs either way — your template is the foundation the result is built around, not a replacement for it.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.sub: Your copy of your data, and the right to be forgotten.
privacy.exportBody: Download everything MarketingOS stores about you as a JSON file: account, campaigns you created with their rounds and results, votes, corrections, templates, masked API keys, Tools runs, AI usage and your private memory.
privacy.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account and personal data. Campaigns you created in a team organisation stay with that team; your personal workspace is deleted. This can't be undone.

obs.title: AI usage & reliability
obs.sub: The last 14 days of AI calls for this organisation, by day and provider.
obs.empty: No AI calls recorded yet for this organisation.
obs.note: Failures that were retried on another provider still count here. A rising failure rate on one provider usually means its free quota ran out.

brand.title: Brand kit
brand.sub: How every campaign in this organisation should sound.
brand.voicePlaceholder: e.g. Warm and plain-spoken. Short sentences. Never pushy.
brand.how: The AI follows the voice and word lists when writing copy. Drafts with a forbidden word are rewritten and can never be sent. The sign-off is added to posts and emails that don't include it.

ab.hint: Each round writes a second variant and sends each half of the list one of them; clicks decide the winner.
ab.explain: Click rates per half of the list, compared with a two-proportion z-test; a winner needs p < 0.05.
